Question 3

Write the following first-order linear ODE in standard form. (cos⁡x)dydx+sin⁡2x−(sin⁡x)y=0

a
dydx−(tan⁡x)y=−2sin⁡x
b
 dydx−(cot⁡x)y=2cos⁡x
c
 dydx+2sin⁡x=(tan⁡x)y
d
 dydx+(sec⁡x)y=−2sin⁡2x
e
 dydx+sin⁡2x=(sec⁡x)y
